title: A/R Collection: changing the Past due filter keeps the sort
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a customer, customer A, with overdue invoices on today's date: one 1 to 30 days past due, and two 31 to 60 days past due with different open balances.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with customer A's group expanded.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Open Balance" header once.
  2. In the Past due filter, tick "31-60 days".
  3. Expand customer A's group.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The rows in customer A's group sort by Open Balance, largest first.
  • "Open Balance" is marked as the sorted column (a small arrow beside its heading).

Step 2:

  • The report reloads with only the invoices 31 to 60 days past due (and any credits) left.
  • Every group is collapsed.

Step 3:

  • The rows in the group are still sorted by Open Balance, largest first.
  • "Open Balance" is still marked as the sorted column (a small arrow beside its heading).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows), story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S2-R7: “The sort is kept while the user stays on the report: changing the as-of date, loading more rows by scrolling, and changing the customer, vendor, Past due or Location filter keep it.”
  • S5-R16: “With ranges ticked, A/R Detail, A/R Collection, A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices keep only the invoices and bills whose days past due on the as-of date fall in a ticked range, and always keep credit memos, deposits and vendor credits.”
  • S4-N1: “Changing the as-of date, the customer or vendor filter, the Past due filter or the Location filter collapses every group, as changing the date or filter does today.”
